discovery_row.name: Wall Street Oasis
discovery_row.description:
🧠 What Is Wall Street Oasis (WSO)?

Wall Street Oasis (WSO) is the largest online community and career platform for students and professionals pursuing careers in finance, consulting, and related industries. Founded by Patrick Curtis, a former investment banker, WSO combines expert education, mentorship, and a massive peer-driven ecosystem to help people break into elite finance roles—from investment banking and private equity to hedge funds, venture capital, and management consulting.

🌐 The Community

At its core, WSO began as a forum—a place where finance professionals and aspiring candidates could share insights, discuss recruiting tips, and demystify the industry. Over time, it’s grown into a global community of over 900,000 members, including analysts, associates, VPs, partners, and students from top universities worldwide.

The forums cover topics such as:
Interview and recruiting experiences
Resume and networking advice
Compensation data and bonus reports
MBA and graduate program discussions
Lateral transitions and career changes

🚀 WSO Academy

WSO Academy is the platform’s flagship educational program—a structured, high-touch accelerator designed to help students and career changers land top finance offers within months, not years.

It combines:
Live office hours with senior mentors and finance professionals
Bootcamps covering financial modeling, valuation, and technical interview prep
Access to 2,000+ mentors across investment banking, private equity, and hedge funds
Networking and application strategy guidance
Full tuition refund guarantee if students don’t land a lucrative offer within a set timeframe

The program is tailored to four key groups:
🎓 Target school students
🏫 Non-target students
🔁 Career changers
🌍 International candidates

discovery_row.name: Inman
discovery_row.description:
The smartest real estate professionals start their day with Inman.

Inman is the leading source of news, events, insights, and community for the residential real estate industry. Trusted by real estate agents, brokers, executives, and decision-makers across the housing landscape, Inman delivers independent journalism covering market trends, technology, business strategy, economic forces, and the people shaping the future of real estate.

Built on a foundation of journalistic integrity and powered by a modern media platform, Inman has helped real estate professionals navigate an ever-changing industry for decades. Guided by the belief that independent reporting can thrive alongside live events, industry sponsorships, digital media, and a robust professional community, Inman has earned its reputation as one of the most trusted media brands in the country.

NEWS
Inman Select is the premium subscription platform, providing exclusive access to industry-leading journalism, sharp analysis, special reports, market insights, and expert commentary. Subscribers gain the information and perspective needed to understand market shifts, identify emerging trends, and make informed business decisions.

EVENTS
Inman Connect is where real estate's brightest minds gather to learn, network, and grow in person. Keynotes, panels, workshops, and curated networking opportunities put attendees in the room with the leaders defining the industry while delivering practical knowledge attendees can apply to their businesses. For thousands, Inman Connect serves as a much needed change of scenery and space to learn, grow, and connect.

COMMUNITY
Inman Community is an online platform available to Inman event attendees and members, empowering them to connect, network, share knowledge, and have niche conversations with their peers before, during, and after events. 

To learn more about Inman Select, attend Inman Connect, submit a story, or explore sponsorship opportunities, visit Inman.com.
